## Problem

Describe the current behavior and the reason for changing it.

## Scope

Name the affected targets or files and the proposed change.
State what remains outside this request.

## Evidence

Link the relevant source, prior issue, or pull request.
Separate confirmed observations from unverified assumptions.

## Acceptance

List the observable results and verification needed to complete this request.

## Ownership and next action

Name the owner and the next concrete action.
